newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Block trades active on Lithuanian bourse.
newsitem.headline: Block trades active on Lithuanian bourse.

text.p: Lithuania's share market was dominated by block trades on Monday, with Hermis Bank standing out, and bourse indices showed a mixed trend, dealers said.
Block trades accounted for 1.42 million litas of activity with Hermis turning over 692,000 litas. The central market showed a low 247,000 litas of activity.
The official list of leading blue chips inched up 1.18 points to 889.55 while the wider group A index lost 0.06 points to 1875.84.
Traders said the summer period was still keeping the market quiet.

"It seems that the holiday season is having an impact and I forecast that the majority of prices will make no abrupt changes on comparatively low turnover on the central market this week," said Vilfima broker Aiste Kraujalyte said.
Hermis' block trades were at 187 litas while on the central market the shares rose to 186 litas from 185 litas on turnover of 22,000 litas.
Vilniaus Bank remained unchanged at 235 litas on 30,000 litas of trade on the central market and registered business of 330,000 litas in block trades at 236 litas price.
Siauliu Bank rebounded to 85 litas from 79.4 litas last Friday on turnover of 17,000 litas.
TV screens producer Ekranas saw the highest turnover on the central market of 67,000 litas rising slightly to 5.52 litas from 5.51 litas
